description: This is a Java unit test class for the Shutdown class in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It tests instantiation, immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and equality of the Shutdown command objects.

classes.name: ShutdownTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the Shutdown command functionality and behaviors.

methods.name: initTestConstants
methods.description: Static setup method to initialize shared test constants before all tests run.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Setup method to initialize the object under test before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Test to verify that the Shutdown class is immutable and its subcomponents are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Test to verify correct implementation of equals and hashCode methods.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithNullReason
methods.description: Test to ensure that providing null reason throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: getReasonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Test to verify that getReason() returns the expected ShutdownReason.

methods.name: getCategoryReturnsModify
methods.description: Test to verify that getCategory() returns Command.Category.MODIFY.

methods.name: getTypeReturnsExpected
methods.description: Test to verify that getType() returns the correct type string.

methods.name: getDittoHeadersReturnsExpected
methods.description: Test to verify that getDittoHeaders() returns the headers used during initialization.

methods.name: getIdReturnsDummyId
methods.description: Test to verify that getEntityId() returns a dummy entity ID.

methods.name: getResourceTypeReturnsCommonCommandResourceType
methods.description: Test to verify that getResourceType() returns the expected resource type string.

methods.name: fromJsonWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Test to verify that fromJson() correctly reconstructs a Shutdown object from JSON.

methods.name: fromJsonWithoutReason
methods.description: Test to verify that if the reason is omitted in JSON, the object defaults to ShutdownNoReason.INSTANCE.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Test to verify that toJson() returns the expected JSON representation.

methods.name: toJsonWithoutReason
methods.description: Test to verify that toJson() omits the reason field when the reason is ShutdownNoReason.

methods.name: toStringContainsExpected
methods.description: Test to verify that the toString() method contains key information about the object.
